summary.text: Shri Thanedar represents Michigan's 13th Congressional District, which includes much of Wayne County, the city of Detroit, Grosse Pointe and Downriver, in the U.S. House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to Congress in 2022 and previously served in the Michigan House of Representatives.
Born in southern India, he came to the United States in 1979, earned a Ph.D. in chemistry from the University of Akron in 1982, and became a U.S. citizen in 1988.
He worked as a researcher and then built companies as an entrepreneur, and ran for Governor of Michigan in 2018.
